author: Unreal Engine
description: Sick of zombie bugs that keep coming back in your most important systems?  Do you want to get the most out of your limited QA hours?  Join us as Andrew Fray explores the test automation tooling in Unreal 5 and learn how good automation can let you focus on gameplay instead of bugs.
title: Practical Test Automation In Unreal | Inside Unreal

author: Unreal Engine
description:
What if relevant, targeted, high-quality synthetic data was just a prompt away? Simulation is an indispensable tool for building physical AI systems, enabling faster training, safe testing, and systematic discovery of edge cases. 

However, simulation workflows often require proficiency with 3D tools and are constrained by slow, cumbersome customization. Generative world models, by contrast, are intuitive and highly flexible—but they lack the physical grounding, reproducibility, and controllability required for meaningful training and validation. 

In this talk recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, Duality AI introduces Unreal Engine–based vibe simulation: a new approach that reconciles the intuitiveness and flexibility of generative world models with the accuracy, determinism, and physical grounding of simulation. 

Vibe simulations enable users to modify scenarios using natural language prompts and an intuitive agentic interface, while retaining the precise control required for AI i
title: World Modeling and Vibe Simulation with Unreal Engine | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
The quest for enhanced realism and deeper player immersion is constantly constrained by performance. Fast and accurate simulation is a cornerstone of next-generation games, and for several years, we’ve been pushing the limits of the Unreal Engine physics engine, Chaos. 

Watch this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 to uncover a long-term optimization journey that has delivered up to 40% performance gains in targeted scenarios—without sacrificing stability, backward compatibility, or memory footprint.

This has not been the result of a single fix or isolated optimization, but of a sustained, methodical effort driven by deep profiling, scalable algorithm design, aggressive use of multithreading, and meticulous low-level code optimization.

title: Breaking Performance Barriers: Lessons from Optimizing Chaos | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
